records.title: CoVisco: Codec-Native Vision Encoder with Native Token Compression for Unified Image-Video Understanding
records.reading_boundary: Sections 3 and 4; conclusion; appendices A.3, C, D; official repository README; no independent reproduction
records.selection_reason: Separates internal fine-grained representation from the token budget exposed to a language model.
evidence_locations: Section 3.2-3.6: abstract-mediated cross-segment communication and selectable patch output
Section 4.2/Table 3: matched codec input at 504 resolution; 400 LLM output tokens versus 10,368 ViT input tokens
Appendix D: same language backbone, projector family and instruction data
limitations: Compact-token results vary by task; image OCR transfer remains weak.
Input and output token budgets differ; no 26-fold end-to-end speed claim is supported.
Codec comparisons and uniform-frame comparisons have different sampling assumptions.
records.code_status: Official repository and README verified; encoder weights linked by README; not downloaded or executed

records.title: FutureRay: Control-Aligned Future Range for Agile Quadruped Navigation
records.reading_boundary: III-VII and conclusion; no independent reproduction
records.selection_reason: Tests a forecasting interface under fixed perception, planning and locomotion, linking prediction errors to clearance and braking.
evidence_locations: IV-A/B: five-frame history; shared 0.5-second range forecast; footprint and reaction-braking queries
VI-A/Table I: 60 paired scenes, one simulator seed; range and risk packet is changed jointly
limitations: The shared forecast is not recomputed for each candidate future pose.
The controlled experiment changes range and risk together.
Paired scenes share training procedural families; one simulator seed; hardware trials are qualitative.
Released-checkpoint transfer comparison is separate from matched-planner ablation.
records.code_status: No author project or code release established in the opened arXiv sources
